review_evidence: README identifies a mathematical Lean formalization of Rubik's cubes proving solvability iff validity and the exact cardinality of solvable cubes.
The eleven primary modules formalize orientations, pieces, stickers, moves, permutations, invariants, solvability, equivalences, and cardinality, all directly supporting those stated results.
No current-primary module is merely build/generated/documentation material, so no safe hard exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Rubik's-cube mathematical formalization and its proof modules.
